per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

notes: Direction is the line: a cast **to** a type from src/ or harness/ is a stand-in; `as unknown as Record<string, unknown>` (harnessPlanState.test.ts:137) goes the other way and is refusal-test input engineering.md sanctions (*A seam gate reads what the real writer wrote*).
